items.title: Mini-Docker Runtime
items.description: I was part of the team that developed a basic container runtime in Go to execute isolated processes and understand how containers work in Linux.
points: I implemented detached execution, the process supervisor, log capture and orderly termination using SIGTERM and SIGKILL.
The project used namespaces, cgroups v2 and rootfs, with YAML configuration and state persistence in JSON.

items.title: HotelSys - Hotel Management System
items.description: I collaborated in the development of a web system using Python and Django to manage reservations, guests, rooms, stays, cleaning and billing.
points: I was responsible for the Reservations and Guests modules, implementing customer registration, reservation management, availability validation and overlap prevention.
I integrated reservations with check-in and stay processes using Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL; the system also included real-time features.

items.title: FairBet Lab - Educational Betting Platform
items.description: I participated in the development of an educational platform using Django to simulate sports betting with virtual currency and no real money.
points: The platform included users, virtual wallets, events, odds, bets, settlements, responsible gaming and auditing.
The solution used a REST API with JWT authentication and real-time updates through Django Channels, Redis and WebSockets.

items.title: Volunteer Management Platform
items.description: I participated in the development of a web platform using Java and Spring Boot to digitize the management of a volunteer organization.
points: The system centralized the management of users, activities, donations, inventory and treasury in a monolithic architecture defined by the team.
The platform included authentication, access control, Excel report generation and PDF certificate issuance.
